title: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-Training for Open-Set Object Detection
layout_note: Overview panel on the left half, two detail panels stacked on the right half; each panel is titled by a numbered purple pill ('1. Model Overall', '2. A Feature Enhancer Layer', '3. A Decoder Layer'). In the overview, a text branch (left) and an image branch (right) rise in parallel from the inputs at the bottom, merge through a fusion block and continue upward to the outputs and losses.
grouping: Panels are split by solid purple rules (one vertical, one horizontal). Each detail panel is linked to its block in the overview by a wide pale translucent wedge fanning from the block's edge to the panel's container, which repeats the block's fill.
shapes_depth: Text features are rows of slanted thin 3-D rods (pale green-yellow) and image features are dark blue 3-D cubes with a grid; queries are short yellow 3-D rods. Fusion blocks have a horizontal gradient fill from pale green (text side) to blue (image side); the decoder block is solid yellow. Backbones are a green rectangle (text) and a blue trapezoid (image). The input text is a rounded pill in typewriter font ('cat . person . mouse .') with a faded second prompt behind it; the input image is a photo with a faded copy behind. Outputs are tiny box crops of the photo; losses are red arrows rising to labels at the top. The contrastive objective is a grid whose header column is the input text in rotated typewriter letters, with '1' in matching cells. Attention boxes mark K,V and Q at their inputs.
proposed_highlight: The modality-fusion blocks are told apart by the green-to-blue gradient fill, the visual mix of the two modality colours; each is expanded in a detail panel joined to it by a translucent zoom wedge.
lesson: Encode the two modalities as two glyph types and colours (text = row of thin green rods, image = blue grid cube) and fill every block that fuses them with a green-to-blue gradient, so fusion is visible without labels.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2303.05499); venue ECCV as recorded from Semantic Scholar, the venue's year not verified.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
